_comment: Proposed by route-orbit-lite-1 (HelpersDetail, 2026-10-16) for the orchestrator; not in migration/parity-exemptions.json. Evidence: diagnostic parity runs with the Q1 cloneQuery (scratchpad) and the stamped reports in migration/screens/HelpersDetail/parity/.

rules.reason: MenuIcon__UpdatedOSUI with MenuAction Auto shows the back arrow when there is a screen to go back to: the states were captured via OrbitLanding → EventDetail (states.json via), parity opens the route by URL with no previous screen, so the clone shows no back arrow (missing .back, 41x38 → 20x0) and the title / header-right shift by its width. Capture artifact; auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
rules.evidence: migration/screens/HelpersDetail/analysis/states.json (via); parity/default.json, loading.json, offline.json (class missing .back); same rule as VIA-BACK-MENUICON-EVENTDETAIL / -MILESTONEDETAIL

rules.reason: The header title (In_EventName) was masked by the capture: its bullets fit one line, the fictional title of the same word lengths (7 5 11 1 5 3 4, mocks/fictional/orbit.ts) wraps to two lines in the clone, so the header is 16 px taller and the content wrapper 16 px shorter (758 → 742). Text-mask capture artifact (as CAPTURE-MASKED-TITLE-EVENTDETAIL-HEADER); auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
rules.evidence: parity/default.expected.png vs default.build.png (one line of bullets vs two lines); parity/*.json layout 390×758 → 390×742
